levels.name: directive
levels.note: only folders matching this regex are tree levels; every other entry under org/missions (EXTERNAL, INFRASTRUCTURE, PORTAL, *.yaml, README) is the MSTR mission register and is NOT read by tree tools

levels.name: macro
levels.note: a macro folder may exist under a directive only when it is in that directive's ratified list; a macro repeats across directives by design (NFRA under D0 and D11)

levels.name: project
levels.note: PROJECT_CODE ::= MACRO '_' NAME; the underscore is the separator and nothing else; the folder name IS the code. NAME UPPER BOUND WIDENED 12 -> 18 on 2026-09-09 by 1.0.0_SA_CTO~Z. Basis is a MEASUREMENT, and the FIRST cut of this note recorded the WRONG one -- corrected here in place. Andrew ratified the project code NFRA_IAMROLES202609 (tail 14) and a bound of 12 could not express it, so a sovereign-ratified code was unregisterable under the tree. MEASURED across org/projects/*.json: 356 register rows, of which 325 carry THIS SHAPE (one underscore, [A-Z0-9] tail); the other 31 fail for reasons that are NOT length (a second underscore, which this note deliberately forbids). Among the 325 shape-valid codes, a bound of 12 refuses NINE -- NFRA_REPOCOHERENCEGRAPH (18), OPAL_VENDORPROVENANCE (16), NFRA_SUBSTRATECARDING (16), NFRA_NESTEDABSTRACT (14), MDPF_COTREMEDIATION (14), OPAL_PORTALREFRESH (13), OPAL_CONSOLIDATION (13), NFRA_COMPASSURANCE (13), NFRA_C3MATERIALIZE (13) -- so the bound was already inconsistent with the register it governs. 18 IS THE MEASURED MAXIMUM among shape-valid codes, NOT invented headroom and NOT the 14 of the author's own artifact: a bound tailored to admit one file is the self-granting shape this estate refuses, and invented headroom is an unmeasured exact constant. A code longer than 18 RE-OPENS this bound rather than being silently admitted. NO RATIONALE FOR 12 EVER APPEARED: this note previously explained only the STRUCTURE and never the length. The CHARACTER CLASS IS UNCHANGED, so lowercase, a missing separator and a second underscore are all still refused -- the validator's R1 mutant fixture (ETFS_gd) still discriminates and its 38/38 self-test still passes. CORRECTION RECORD: the first cut of this widening said 20 and cited 41 already-exceeding codes, both wrong -- 41 counted SHAPE failures as LENGTH failures, and its named maximum (MDPF_CHANNEL_INDEPENDENCE, tail 20) fails on the second underscore and is not evidence about length at all. Caught by a control that expected that code to be ADMITTED at 20 and measured that it was not. REVERSIBLE: narrowing back would un-register NFRA_IAMROLES202609 and must say so. LOWER BOUND 4 -> 3 in the SAME session, on 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z's verification (msg 20659), and the finding is against the act above: A BOUND HAS TWO ENDS AND THE FIRST WIDENING MOVED ONLY ONE. The census that produced 18 had the answer to the other end in the same array and this author read only the top of the range. RE-MEASURED INDEPENDENTLY AT BOTH SEATS AND THE FIGURES AGREE: 357 register rows, 326 shape-valid, measured MIN name length 3, measured MAX 18. A bound of 4 REFUSED THREE shape-valid live register codes -- ADVI_49F, ADVI_TWR, NFRA_CSE, all name length 3, all well-formed on every other axis. LATENT RATHER THAN LIVE when found: none of the three is in org/missions/** (the tree holds 7 projects, all names >= 6 chars), so nothing was refusing. IT WOULD HAVE STOPPED BEING LATENT ON THE NEXT TREE REGISTRATION OF ANY OF THEM, and NFRA_CSE is a NAMED FUTURE ONE (3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z's 09-04 next-steps carry its channel at L8 when its round opens) -- i.e. this session's REPO-GLOBAL tree-gate outage replayed from the other end of the same regex, on a code Andrew has already ratified. 3 IS THE MEASURED MINIMUM, on the same basis as 18. 3.0.0_SA_CVO~Z deliberately did NOT propose this widening, on the correct grounds that a lower bound is a real refusal surface and 3-char names might be intentionally discouraged, which would be a design call with an owner; it is taken here anyway because NO RATIONALE FOR 4 EXISTS ANYWHERE EITHER -- the same absence that justified moving 12 -- and three live register codes already violate it, so the alternative reading is that three active projects are non-conforming and nobody has said so. IF 3-CHAR NAMES ARE MEANT TO BE REFUSED, narrow it back and the finding inverts into exactly that: name the three

row_path_agreement.directive: must equal the directive folder name
row_path_agreement.macro_code: must equal the macro folder name AND the code's prefix before '_'
row_path_agreement.project_code: must equal the project folder name

project_folder.note: sub-folders are created when their step first writes; an absent sub-folder is not a violation

value_enums._rule: a row field named here is valid ONLY if its value is in the enum the GATE compares against; the enum is read from the gate's source BY AST at run time (a module-level literal assignment), never copied into this file or the generator -- Rule 24(iv): one carrier, so the generator and to-pipeline-gate.py cannot render two verdicts over one row. A missing source or symbol FAILS CLOSED (rc 2), never an empty enum

fabric.note: the gate compares str(fabric).strip().lower(); the generator mirrors that

status.why: the gate does not read status; the flat register carries 12 distinct live values (complete, closed, active, inactive, merged, ...) and enumerating them is a Rule 24 authoring act nobody has asked for

rules: an index entry carrying `home` is GENERATED from the tree row at `home`/project.json and is never hand-edited
a flat row without `home` is a HAND-WRITTEN register row for a project that lives outside the tree (the dual-register period, spec s.8) and is never overwritten by the generator
every compared field of a generated entry must equal the tree row's value -- drift is a violation (INDEX-DRIFT), because the index is a second carrier and an unenforced second carrier drifts

directives_yaml.rule: every tree project appears in its directive's members.projects list (refusal R5); the generator VALIDATES the list and prints the exact additions, it NEVER writes org/missions/DIRECTIVES.yaml (lane TIER0_DIRECTIVES_REGISTER; comp-directives FORM tripwire)

refusals.test: a folder at the macro or project level does not match its level regex, or a row's project_code fails the project regex
the macro is not in MACROS.yaml directives.<D>.macros, or that directive's ratification does not start with RATIFIED
the project_code is not estate-unique: it appears twice in the tree, or a hand-written flat row (no `home`) carries the same code
a row field disagrees with its path component (directive / macro_code / project_code)
a tree project is absent from DIRECTIVES.yaml directives.<D>.members.projects
a project folder has no project.json
a row lacks a required field
a row's dep_stage or fabric is present but not in the gate's enum (value_enums), after the gate's own normalization
a valid tree project has no generated index entry (remedy: derive --write)
a generated index entry's compared field differs from the tree row
a generated index entry's `home` has no tree row
